title: The two chart restriction formulas before regrouping
statement:
Fix a finite purity setting $P$ with $P.extension=\bot$, and assume NormalizedInputs P as defined in [def-sp-nested-affine-formula-data]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type smooth morphisms of relative dimensions $d,e\ge0$, with $Z$ separated of finite type over $k$. Take affine opens $S\subset Z$, $V\subset g^{-1}S$, $U\subset f^{-1}V$ and etale charts $v:V\to\mathbb A^e_S$, $u:U\to\mathbb A^d_V$ over the two restricted maps. Write $h_0=f|_U\,;\,g|_V$, let $ut,vt$ be their canonical tower presentations, and set $k=ut\,;\,\mathbb A^d(vt)$. For every compact-support normalization $\mathcal N$, define $r$ as the pullback of the inverse chartDualizingUnit for $fg$, then canonical dualizing restriction to $(U,S)$, then chartDualizingUnit at $h_0$. Then
$$\mathrm{twistPull}_{U\to X}^{-1}\,j^*(a_{fg})\,r
 =\mathrm{chartPull}_{k,h_0}(\mathrm{total}_{d,e,\mathcal N}),$$
$$\mathrm{twistPull}_{U\to X}^{-1}\,j^*(\mathrm{tensorRoute}_{f,g}\,c^{-1}_{f,g,A_Z})\,r
 =\mathrm{chartPull}_{k,h_0}(\mathrm{iterated}_{d,e}).$$
All the arrows are exactly the published constructions of [def-sp-nested-affine-formula-data]. This assertion contains only the two restriction identities; it asserts no equality of total with iterated, no equality of the two restricted arrows, and no global normalization theorem. Only the affine square over v is Cartesian; the outer square with k and v need not be Cartesian.

proof.text: Restrict f, g and fg to U, V and S. Target-open base change of the inverse orientations and dualizing sigma locality identify r with canonical dualizing restriction. Chart exceptional-mate coherence preserves this restriction and the exceptional compositor.

The affine square over vt is Cartesian, so its affine map is etale. The composite chart equation follows by composing the two chart equations. Apply diagonalOrientationCharts to k and invert its equation. At the total affine projection use the assumed normalization in rank d+e. After blockEq and blockProjection transport, the resulting equation is exactly lhs = chartPull total.

Apply etale_cartesian_tower_tensor_comparison to q,p,vt,ut,the affine map and k. Its first factor becomes the pullback of the q-orientation by smooth base change in the actual Cartesian square and the u chart equation; its second factor becomes the pullback of the p-orientation by the v chart equation. Restore the same inverse exceptional compositor as in the first formula.

Use NormalizedInputs at the coefficient unit for p and at H = omega_p for q. Its domain clause permits omega_p. Factor the tensor of orientations as q^*gammaUnit_p tensor identity, followed by identity tensor gammaUnit_q. By tensor functoriality the second factor followed by theta is gamma_q at omega_p. This is exactly iterated and proves the second restriction formula, with all empty-block unit constraints retained.
